## Checklist (these don't apply to weblate pull requests)

- [ ] I previewed the change locally with `npx hugo server`.
- [ ] If I changed visible text in templates, I ran `python3 find_missing_i18n_strings.py` and committed `i18n/en.json` without hand editing any of the other translation files.
- [ ] New images have alt text, and blog header images are under 500 KB.
- [ ] If this adds, moves, or removes a page, or changes supported versions or architectures, I updated `static/llms.txt`.
- [ ] If an AI assistant helped with this change, I said so in the description so reviewers know to check it closely.
